metadata.name: MedOrbits Document Library
metadata.title: MedOrbits Public Document Library
metadata.description: Central registry for MedOrbits public document resources, including checklists, admission guides, fee guides, and other approved educational downloads.
metadata.purpose: Provide a central, maintainable index of approved public document resources and their category-specific manifests.
metadata.disclaimer: Documents are informational resources. Users must independently confirm current requirements, eligibility, fees, deadlines, and procedures with the relevant official authority.

categories.title: Checklists Library
categories.description: Printable planning checklists for education, admissions, applications, examinations, career development, organization, and study abroad.

categories.title: Admission Guides
categories.description: General and programme-specific admission guidance, including application processes and preparation resources.

categories.title: Fee Guides
categories.description: Education cost-planning resources covering tuition, living costs, scholarships, education loans, counselling charges, and refund policies.

requirements: Each category must have a README and a category manifest at its declared location.
Each manifest must validate against its applicable JSON Schema.
Every published downloadable resource must exist at its declared path.
Resource paths must remain inside the approved assets/documents directory.
Documents must pass content, privacy, accessibility, and file-quality reviews before publication.
Time-sensitive information must be reviewed against the relevant official sources.
Verification claims must be supported by documented evidence.
Public download links must be tested after deployment.
Outdated, withdrawn, or archived resources must not be presented as current guidance.
rules: Only resources with status published may be exposed as public downloads.
Schema validation is not proof of authenticity, accuracy, authorization, or official endorsement.
Never publish applicant records, identity documents, confidential information, credentials, or private personal data in this public directory.
Do not mark a resource published merely because its manifest entry exists.

requirements: Use official issuing-authority sources for time-sensitive admission, eligibility, fee, deadline, and policy claims.
Record source URLs and check dates before claiming official verification.
Content-reviewed resources must not be labelled officially verified.
An official-source link does not automatically establish that the entire document is officially endorsed.
Recheck time-sensitive content before its review due date.

extensions.categoryManifestFilenamePolicy: Use the exact case-sensitive filename declared by this manifest.
